privacy.extension.text: The extension keeps the address of your auto instance and your API token on your device, and nowhere else. When you choose “Send the invoice to auto” on a link, it downloads that file (PDF or XML) and sends it to your auto instance, and to it alone. Every 15 minutes, it asks your instance for the number of invoices to check to show it on its icon. It does not read the pages you visit, does not record your history and sends nothing to a third party. Uninstalling it erases its settings.
privacy.extension.title: Chrome extension “auto: supplier invoices”
privacy.meta.description: Privacy policy of auto: data processed, purposes and retention periods, recipients, security, cookies and exercise of your GDPR rights.
privacy.meta.title: Privacy policy · auto
privacy.no_sale: We do not sell your data, do not run targeted advertising and do not use your data to train third-party artificial intelligence models.
privacy.recipients.text: Authorized staff and our technical processors, hosted in the European Union.
privacy.recipients.title: Recipients
privacy.rights.text: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, portability and post-mortem directives: contact@aphrody.com, answer within one month. The full export of a company's data is available in the service. The right to erasure does not apply to invoices that the law requires to be kept for 10 years (article 17(3)(b) of the GDPR): they are detached from any account, then erased at the end of the period. You may lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr, 3 place de Fontenoy, 75007 Paris).
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.row1.data: Email, hashed password, role, two-factor authentication (encrypted secret)
privacy.row2.retention: 7 days, then a trace in the audit log
privacy.row3.retention: Contract, then 10 years for accounting records
privacy.row4.data: Technical logs, without IP address or email
privacy.security.text: Data isolation per company, encryption in transit and of secrets at rest, hashed passwords, two-factor authentication, encrypted backups, immutable issued documents and audit trail.
